name: Teiran Quait
source:
Teiran's attitude towards you fluctuates wildly between disinterest, outright impudence, and alert wariness, as if he is consciously trying to set you off... and then see the result.

Is there a bigger picture?

Frustrating as he is, no one would blame you for biting back. He may even appreciate it!

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/490618601/queens-crown]Kickstarter[/url]]
